messages:
Priya Nair: Hi all, Im Priya in SDKs, starting today. Couple quick security questions: 1) I got the phishing swimlane email but my company laptop is stuck in transit. Do I need to enroll my personal laptop in MDM to be in scope? 2) Where do I find the Security Basics module in the new learning portal?

Chris (People Ops): welcome Priya! :wave: Youre not required to enroll personal devices. Request a loaner via the Facilities form (https://redwood.intranet/facilities/loaner). We tag you as exempt for phish sims until you have a managed device. Security Basics link is in the handbook: https://redwood.intranet/training/security-basics (first module is mandatory within 72 hours).

Marco IT: @Priya - if you cant wait for the loaner, we can provision a temporary managed VM. Otherwise file the loaner request and reply here with "loaner-request". If you ever decide to enroll a personal Mac, FileVault must be ON. To check: open Terminal and run `fdesetup status`.

Priya Nair: Thanks. Ill do the loaner request. Quick follow-up: does MFA enrollment wait until I have the company device?

Leah InfoSec: MFA is independent. Please complete MFA setup ASAP (its part of account provisioning). Youll get an invite from identity@redwood; use Authenticator app and set a backup method. For the phishing simulation, we usually run a baseline within your first two weeks; if youre on a loaner we mark you as managed and eligible.

PhishSimBot: User Priya Nair added to upcoming phishing cohort on 2025-12-03. Reply with "loaner-request" to request exemption until a managed device is assigned.

Priya Nair: loaner-request. Also completed Security Basics module (just did it). Thanks everyone!

Chris (People Ops): Got it, Priya. Facilities will follow up on the loaner. Added you to the onboarding tracker and sent calendar invites for identity/MFA setup. Welcome aboard! :tada:
